title: [finding] SysMetadataRepository.put never writes the actor onto the sys_metadata row: its own header maps actor → updated_by, but every metadata row reads created_by / updated_by null, so an AI-authored or user-authored draft loses who wrote it
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2791 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2808). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

A metadata write that names its author stores no author on the row. objectstack-ai/cloud#2791 measured it: a draft object written through the AI build agent reads back from `sys_metadata` with `created_by: null`, although the caller passed `actor` to `saveMetaItem`. The only place the actor lands is the history row's `recorded_by`.

## Evidence

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts:49` (header, on `main` and at cloud's pin `56bf27affb`): `actor → updated_by (lookup, optional)`.
- `put()` builds the row (`parentRowData`, `:902` on `main`; around `:689-722` at the pin) with no `created_by` / `updated_by`, and inserts it under `isSystem`, so the engine's own insert stamp has no user either.
- The actor reaches only the history row: `recorded_by: opts.actor ?? null` (`:958-961`, `:1110` on `main`).
- The read side expects the column: `rowToItem` maps `updatedBy: row.updated_by ?? row.created_by ?? null` (`:1527` on `main`).
- The producer in cloud: `service-ai-studio`'s `stageDraft` calls `protocol.saveMetaItem` with `actor` (`metadata-tools.ts:1553-1559` in cloud).
- Related, same family: `InstallPackageRequestSchema` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/package-registry.zod.ts:276`) has no actor field, so a package auto-created by AI authoring cannot record who installed it.

## Who reaches it

- Any metadata write with an actor: the AI build agent, Studio saves, `/meta` PUT. The audit question "who changed this object?" answers from history only; the row itself says nobody.
- objectstack-ai/cloud#2791 acceptance 5 ("`sys_metadata` rows the authoring path writes record `created_by`") waits on this, then on a cloud pin move.

## Wanted

`put()` stamps `created_by` (on insert) and `updated_by` (on every write) from `opts.actor`, as its own header declares. If the declared mapping is wrong instead, the header is corrected and the read side's `updatedBy` follows. Optionally, the install request carries an actor.

Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for `sys_metadata created_by`, `updated_by actor`, `SysMetadataRepository put`. Matches are different and closed: #7749 (bearer `/meta` PUT stamped `actor: 'system'`), #15206, #13433, #7990.
